verdict.rationale: Medusa exposes an official MCP server, but it is scoped to searching documentation for AI tools/IDEs, not to operating the commerce platform itself (products, orders, carts) via natural language. Marketing mentions of a 'Cloud Development Agent' and 'guardrails for agents to build customizations' hint at broader agentic operation but are never elaborated with concrete NL-command examples or independent corroboration. Missing for 10: evidence of natural-language commands actually driving store/admin operations, hands-on examples of agentic customization via the guardrails feature, and independent confirmation of the Cloud Development Agent's capabilities.
